answer: An identity earns its seat through WebAuthn passkey per identity, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Cloning 654 keys multiplies the price 654-fold: 71940 POA locked, or 11118 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. A falcon of doubt is healthy, a karst of proof is required, and a lagoon of patience is the price of a clean panel. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
